verses.2: I have heard so many words of comfort for all of you who have worked hard.
verses.3: What is the meaning of these words from the Spirit? Or what does it mean that you will be punished for refusing to obey them?
verses.4: And I, too, will speak to you with words. My heart is filled with love for you. I will speak to you with my lips and with my voice.
verses.5: I will admonish you with my words, and I will shake your teeth.
verses.6: If I speak not, then do not feel my pain. And let go of what is upon me.
verses.7: But now, let me name each of my committees.
verses.8: And he made me stand up. He gave me strength in my face, so that I could respond.
verses.9: A bird of prey caught me, and it bit me on my cheeks. Its eyes were filled with hatred as it stared at me.
verses.10: They beat me with their fists in anger. They hit my body together, filling me with pain.
verses.11: Be you my refuge, oh Lord! But by the hands of the wicked, I will be destroyed.
verses.12: I was weak, and they tormented me. They grabbed my hair and pulled me down. They made me serve them as their tool.
verses.13: They will take me away, my lords! They will tear apart all my limbs. They will not even give me a chance to live; they will throw me into the earth, where I will be destroyed.
verses.14: May a storm break upon me from before the storms; may Yerushalayim be struck by a great disaster, like a king.
verses.15: I have tied my hair on my head, and I have raised myself up on the peaks of my horns.
verses.16: My face was covered with tears, and on my eyelids there were shadows.
verses.17: For I did not commit any sin, and my prayer was heard.
verses.18: This land will not cover my tears, and it will not be a place for me to cry.
verses.19: Even now, I see Him in the heavens, and I am with Him among the stars.
verses.20: My enemies mock me; their words have blinded my eyes.
verses.21: And he will be exalted with God and with the son of man as his enemy.
verses.22: For the years have passed since Eetayu’s time, and I will not return to my dwelling again.
